spec.problem: Attempt-03 proved raw Git bootstrap materialization for six blobs, then stopped because the runner treated the framework projection root as the attempt materialized root. The manifest, raw-materializer self-test, cwd, and terminal binding therefore used the wrong root contract.
current_repository_truth: PR #94 preserves attempt-03 pre-run inputs and immutable failed evidence on main at eb66464dbe34eca1efae04d856cb752fefde475e
attempt-03 raw Git bootstrap materialization passed for six blobs before the materialized-root contract failed
attempt-03 stopped before consumer projection and Docker and did not test the Stryker sidecar
the C1 baseline tree contains 1869 mode-100644 blobs and one mode-160000 gitlink at ai-governance-framework
the attempt-01 sidecar package graph, plugin binding, probes, configs, adapter, and fixtures remain reusable by exact blob binding
spec.target_outcome: Run one disposable attempt-04 with one mechanically verified materialized-root contract, then preserve one allowed fail-closed terminal.
scope: define framework_projection_root + attempt_repo_relative_path = attempt_materialized_root as the only attempt-root contract
mechanically verify that the materialized runner resides at the derived attempt_materialized_root
derive manifest, raw-materializer self-test, cwd, and terminal binding only from attempt_materialized_root
exercise the root contract with a synthetic nested-path positive case and fail-closed negative cases
materialize selected framework inputs and the C1 consumer baseline with git ls-tree plus git cat-file blob
bind each materialized entry by path, mode, type, OID, SHA-256, and byte length
record the one authorized 160000 gitlink without dereferencing or creating a destination path
fail closed on every unsupported Git mode/type and unauthorized gitlink
prove the EOL-conversion failure family with a synthetic attribute-controlled fixture
execute one disposable sidecar probe from a pushed pre-run commit
non_goals: repair in place or retry attempt-04
change the attempt-03 raw materializer, TCB, consumer projection design, Stryker sidecar design, tool graph, configs, adapter, or fixtures
claim correctness of Git, Python, or the bootstrap launcher
extract a reusable framework materialization layer
affected_surfaces: new c1-stryker-sidecar-attempt-04 manifest, exact-reused raw-object materializer and raw-object self-test, materialized-root contract self-test, bootstrap, runner, and post-run evidence only
boundary_and_api_considerations: the host bootstrap invocation, pinned git.exe, pinned Python, and digest-verified bootstrap/materializer files form the declared TCB
framework_projection_root plus the canonical attempt_repo_relative_path is the sole authority for attempt_materialized_root
consumer repository is read-only and used only as a Git object database
consumer worktree is never mounted into Docker
the consumer baseline is an exact superproject blob projection, not a dereferenced full tree
network is allowed only for npm ci in disposable /tool and /consumer roles and disabled for validation phases
spec.claim_ceiling: Conditional on the declared TCB, attempt-04 may establish only whether its materialized-root contract holds, whether materialized projections equal the committed bytes of the specified Git objects, and whether this exact C1/Stryker sidecar boundary passes its frozen technical checks.
failure_paths: materialized runner path, projection root, or canonical repo-relative attempt path mismatch
raw-object inventory, mode, type, OID, byte, or path mismatch
dependency installation, module resolution, dry-run, or mutation failure
consumer graph change, mount/output leakage, timeout, OOM, or cost ceiling breach
evidence_plan: synthetic materialized-root contract self-test with one nested positive and fail-closed wrong-root, escape, absolute, and backslash cases
synthetic raw-object self-test with an EOL attribute fixture that proves git archive differs while cat-file materialization remains exact
consumer baseline and working-copy raw-object inventories
range, npm, resolution, timeout, dry-run, mutation, graph, mount, leakage, and resource evidence
terminal receipt binding every created evidence artifact by SHA-256 and bytes
spec.implementation_tranche: one pre-run commit and push, one disposable execution, one evidence commit and push, then hard stop

authority.owner_authority: 2026-08-22 explicit approval of the bounded attempt-04 DONE with one materialized-root contract, synthetic nested-path positive and negative tests, exact reuse of attempt-03 technical design blobs, one pre-run freeze, and one fail-closed disposable execution

projection_policy.100644_blob: git cat-file blob, write raw bytes, verify SHA-256 and length
projection_policy.160000_commit: only the exact allowlisted gitlink is recorded; no cat-file, dereference, directory, or file

tcb.claim: The probe is conditional on these executables and the digest-verified bootstrap invocation; it does not prove them correct.

claim_ceiling: Conditional on the declared TCB, this probe may establish only whether materialized projections equal the committed bytes of the specified Git objects and whether this exact C1/Stryker sidecar boundary passes frozen technical checks. It cannot establish Git/Python/bootstrap correctness, validator effect, Skill effect, general reuse, Gate 1 readiness, preregistration, freeze, or any arm result.
